IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Driscoll, Clibborn, Wood, Moeller, Liias, Rolfes, Williams, Simpson, Eddy, Finn, Parker, Carlyle, White, Sells, Morrell, Ormsby, and Van De Wege

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of transportation to design and construct a new, separated right turn lane at the intersection of state route number 195 and Cheney-Spokane Road.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a project at the intersection of state routenumber 195 and CheneySpokane Road; adding a new section to chapter47.01 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the intersectionof state route number 195 and CheneySpokane Road is located in arapidly growing area within the city of Spokane. The legislatureintends to reduce collisions due to the heavy left turn movements fromCheneySpokane Road onto state route number 195.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of transportation shall design and construct a new,separated right turn lane at the intersection of state route number 195and CheneySpokane Road to improve visibility and traffic flow. Theproject must include roadway excavation, earthwork, embankmentcompaction, surfacing, HMA pavement, curbing, illumination, drainage,signing, and striping.

If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2009, in the omnibus transportation appropriations act, thisact is null and void.
